lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Thursday’s federal budget will look to make life easier for Canada’s small- and medium-sized businesses, says Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne, The Canadian Press reports.
B.C. First Nations file legal challenges to feds’ Pacific Link pipeline decision, Global News reports.
What is Donald Trump’s closing message to voters?, The Canadian Press reports.
Supreme Court rejects Trump’s request in California mail ballots dispute, CBS News reports.
JD Vance says Haley Stevens’ endorsement of GOP’s Mike Rogers will ‘certainly’ help Michigan Senate race, Fox News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
